desc: The BTi30 is purpose-built for shooters who demand precision, reliability, and adaptability. Featuring swappable vented or sealed end caps, a HUB-compatible mounting system and external fluting for enhanced cooling, the BTi30 delivers consistent performance across multiple platforms. Each unit receives a premium C-Series Cerakote finish, available in Graphite Black, Tactical Grey or Flat Dark Earth, to ensure lasting protection and refined appearance.
